dcterms:description: A dataset collected from California department of transportation describing the road occupy rate of Los Angeles County highway network, aggregated to daily intervals with 80 days of data points.
dcterms:title: Traffic Dataset

dcterms:description: A dataset containing hourly electricity consumption records from 321 clients, merged to obtain a daily interval time series dataset with size 321 × 1096.
dcterms:title: Electricity Consumption Dataset

dcterms:description: A dataset consisting of video recordings of smoke from the chimney of a factory taken in Hokkaido in 2007, resized to obtain a third-order time series dataset of size 36×64×100.
dcterms:title: Smoke Video Dataset

dcterms:description: A dataset containing 105 weekly sales records of 9 personal computers from 2017 to 2019.
dcterms:title: PC Sales Dataset

dcterms:description: A dataset containing 2246 material items for making a product, each with 24 monthly demand quantities.
dcterms:title: Raw Materials Dataset
